scope: Declared grid for the descriptive H1-H3 estimands of lcb_ngpu_lean_theory.py. Every parameter is a scenario assumption, none is measured. The capacity rate is the energy-exclusive capital and hosting cost of one GPU hour; public rental prices are payment L only and never enter it.
response_fee_reading: 0 is the archived per-token tariff as listed (the preregistered reading). 0.04 is an exploratory counterfactual fixed fee per response, not an archived price.
anchor_note: Anchor ids refer to data/calibration/public-prices-2026-10-08.json. Coder and Nemotron have no durable archived tariff, so they get no bill, alpha_C or admission interval. The hidden-token rate equals the output rate (scenario assumption).
